mapper.select: SELECT INT_RATE*100 intRate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EFF_DATE = ( select max(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') )

SELECT DISTINCT A.INT_RATE*100 intRate, B.WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT B WHERE B.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.COMPONENT_ID = A.INT_RATE_ID AND A.EFF_DATE IN ( SELECT MAX(C.EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO C, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT D WHERE D.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.COMPONENT_ID = C.INT_RATE_ID AND C.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY D.COMPONENT_ID )
